note: Utah's 9 no_catalog rows. 2 added (the Onion Creek pair off SR-128), 7 excluded. Both adds are pinned on OSM campground outlines: RIDB put Lower Onion Creek 4 km off and Upper Onion Creek ~35 km away in the La Sals. Campendium's dated rig lengths were the size evidence where the BLM publishes none.

added.name: Lower Onion Creek Campground (Colorado River, Moab)
Upper Onion Creek Campground (Fisher Towers, Moab)

excluded.name: Cowboy Camp Campground (Moab)
excluded.why: BLM: 'High clearance required, no RVs, trailers or pull campers'

excluded.name: Deer Creek Campground (Burr Trail)
excluded.why: BLM: 'does not accommodate travel trailers due to site limitations'

excluded.name: Lonesome Beaver Campground (Henry Mtns)
excluded.why: BLM: 'Due to road conditions the campground can be challenging to access'; 8,000 ft on the Sawmill Basin Road

excluded.name: McMillan Spring Campground (Henry Mtns)
excluded.why: rough, narrow dirt roads up the Bull Creek Pass byway; larger trailers face significant challenges

excluded.name: The Ledge Campground (Kane Creek, Moab)
excluded.why: a tight, steep switchback and creek crossings; not recommended for vehicles over 22 ft or long trailers

excluded.name: Birch Creek Campground (Woodruff)
excluded.why: 4 walk-in sites 50 yd from the lot; RVs may only park in the lot

excluded.name: Sids Mountain Wilderness - The Wedge
excluded.why: the RIDB row is the wilderness area; the Wedge Overlook designated dispersed sites are described only by aggregators and are proposed for closure. Revisit as a dispersed-site add if AWH wants it
